newsitem.title: UK: Higher prices subdue UK meals and feeds trade.
newsitem.headline: Higher prices subdue UK meals and feeds trade.

text.p: Higher prices on the UK meals and feeds market during Friday resulting from overnight gains in Chicago kept most buyers sidelined.
"We've hardly had any calls today, it seems a lot of people have not even come in," said one trader.
High protein soymeal prices ex-mill and stores were up around two stg a tonne.
Business was confined to home produced wheat feed with pellets fetching 96 stg a tonne for spot ex-mill London and meal 87 stg.
